name: RM277
description:
One of the entrants to the NGSW programme. The RM277 possesses a unique firemode arrangement that functions a lot like the M1918 BAR and allows it to switch between high rpm with high recoil, and low rpm with low recoil.
The specialized 6.8mm TVCM ammo this gun uses is relatively poor up close due to overpenetration characteristics. Best used at mid-range.

Model submitted by Rialag.
